description: This file defines serialization, copying, and surrogate handling for ImmutableDictionary<TKey, TValue> in Orleans serialization framework. It includes a serializer class, a surrogate struct, and a deep copier class for immutable dictionaries.

classes.name: ImmutableDictionaryCodec<TKey, TValue>
classes.description: Serializer for ImmutableDictionary<TKey, TValue> using surrogate serialization.

classes.name: ImmutableDictionarySurrogate<TKey, TValue>
classes.description: Surrogate type used for serializing ImmutableDictionary<TKey, TValue>.

classes.name: ImmutableDictionaryCopier<TKey, TValue>
classes.description: Deep copier implementation for ImmutableDictionary<TKey, TValue>.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the ImmutableDictionary<TKey, TValue>.
